title: Design 1: word x gender interaction on a management-readiness question
description: Insert 'Colleagues describe her/him as <word>.' into real bios; 2x2 gender x (neutral vs loaded word). Decision: ready for a management role? Measure: (loaded - neutral) for women minus the same for men. Each pair is its own control.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Design 1 measures loaded-word by gender interaction

Scenario: The double difference isolates the word's effect from the gender's
  Given real bios with 'Colleagues describe her/him as <word>' inserted in a 2x2 gender by neutral/loaded-word design, each pair serving as its own control
  When I run bd score on the management-readiness task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/gendered-language-design1 reports (loaded - neutral) for women minus the same difference for men, with a 95% interval and the pre-registered verdict

right_now_summary: The team is measuring how loaded words affect management-readiness judgments by gender.
